description: Authoritative manifest for JavaScript libraries vendored for Teachhelper offline use.

packages.name: jszip
packages.updateNotes: Fetch the matching npm package release, replace local runtime and license files, refresh SHA-256 hashes, then run scripts/audit.py.

packages.name: @cantoo/pdf-lib
packages.updateNotes: Maintained fork of pdf-lib (cantoo-scribe/pdf-lib); the vendored UMD build dist/pdf-lib.min.js still exposes the global PDFLib. Fetch the matching npm package release, replace local runtime and license files, refresh SHA-256 hashes, then run scripts/audit.py.

packages.name: pdfjs-dist
packages.updateNotes: Track Mozilla PDF.js releases and advisories closely because PDF parsing handles untrusted files. Replace pdf.mjs and pdf.worker.mjs together, refresh hashes, then run scripts/audit.py and PDF workflows. Re-check that PDFWorker._isSameOrigin still exists, because src/shared/pdf-vendor.js overrides it for opaque-origin module frames.

packages.name: qrcode
packages.updateNotes: Fetch the matching npm package release, rebuild src/modules/qr/vendor/qrcode.min.js from the tagged source with npm run build, refresh SHA-256 hashes, then run scripts/audit.py and QR workflows.

packages.name: jsqr
packages.updateNotes: Fetch the matching npm package release, replace src/modules/qr/vendor/jsQR.js with dist/jsQR.js, refresh SHA-256 hashes, then run scripts/audit.py and QR scan workflows.
